items.title: Connect actor helper calls to the production TTS workflow
acceptance_criteria: Each supported TTS identity resolves to the intended actor ID and token variable
StartTts runs before audio playback
StopTts runs after playback completion or cleanup
A delayed stop from an older playback cannot stop a newer session
Non-actor TTS users continue using the existing overlay behavior
items.notes: Keep raw actor tokens in Streamer.bot persisted globals, not in repository files.

items.title: Run an end-to-end multi-actor TTS test
acceptance_criteria: Every configured AI voice activates only its assigned actor
Speaking starts before audible playback and returns to idle afterward
Expressions and emotes remain actor-scoped
Back-to-back requests preserve stale-session protection

items.title: Build the LAN-enabled Windows release
acceptance_criteria: The standard and LAN executables build successfully
The release ZIP is created
LAN setup, actor, and Streamer.bot documentation are present
The Streamer.bot helper source is present

items.title: Smoke-test the packaged release from a clean folder
acceptance_criteria: Certificate setup completes
Existing machine-data can be restored from backup
Main and actor OBS URLs render
Model and emote assets load
LAN restart recovery works
Streamer.bot can reach the actor API

items.title: Update PR #8 after release validation
acceptance_criteria: Remaining validation items are documented accurately
The pull request is marked ready only with explicit owner approval

items.title: Retest the combined LAN integration branch
acceptance_criteria: Localhost mode remains unchanged
Secure LAN machine registration and private assets work
AI Actors and Streamer.bot controls work
OBS main and actor sources recover after restart

items.title: Promote secure LAN mode to main
Record an optional OBS CPU and GPU baseline
acceptance_criteria: Record active, inactive, and hidden browser-source measurements
Document OBS visibility settings used during the measurement
items.notes: This is useful evidence but is not currently required to prove functional correctness.

maintenance.rule: When an item is completed, record the result in project-status.json, remove or mark the roadmap item complete, update updated_at in both files, and add a concise CHANGELOG.md entry.
maintenance.security: Never place live tokens, authenticated OBS URLs, or certificate secrets in roadmap files.
